summary: The registrant, American Rebel Holdings, filed an 8-K reporting multiple exchange agreements with Streeterville, converting shares of Series E Preferred Stock and a portion of a secured promissory note into common stock. The exchanges involve converting preferred shares at par ($1,000/share) and partitioning a note, all for common stock. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. These are routine debt-to-equity conversions under existing arrangements, not a special situation. The filing lacks a transformative event, premium, or conflict typical of special situations.
